quality.reason: Well-structured digest with specific actionable data points (ETF inflow figures, whale positions with leverage), source attribution, engagement metrics for credibility filtering, and relevance scores for prioritization.

Well-structured digest with fleet health, concrete trading metrics (negative PnL flagged), one specific actionable signal ($HYPE, source, strength), and curated news, though empty [[]] ticker tags on most news items show minor parsing flaws.

Well-structured review with actionable elements: clear position status with close dates, meaningful strategy score trends (ETH decline/recovery pattern), and an explicitly flagged SOL anomaly warranting investigation, though some table fields are empty or N/A.

Well-structured, timestamped alert with actionable signals (84% SOL bid-weighted orderbook, 4 whales/21 position changes with directional bias) and a clean metrics table, though the unexplained divergence between bearish SOL whale flows and the bid-heavy orderbook slightly limits interpretability.

Well-structured daily review with specific per-agent health deltas, clear status flags identifying failing components (meta 45.8 ❌, paper_trader 51.2 ⚠️) that invite action, confirmed scanner recovery, and concrete trading metrics — actionable signal, though the dormant trading status (no trades since May) suggests the trading half adds little day-to-day value.

Well-structured digest with on-topic papers, verifiable arXiv links, dates, abstracts, and transparent methodology notes (rate-limit fallback), delivering clear actionable signal for the target domain.

Well-structured scanner output that goes beyond raw prices: it quantifies probabilities with daily deltas, distinguishes genuine sentiment shifts from expiry-driven repricing (e.g., flagging the Fed +6.0pp as the biggest non-expiry move while labeling SOL's +10pp as expiry noise), and filters out already-resolved markets, making it clearly actionable signal rather than noise.
